clip.tooltip: The CLIP model used for encoding the text.

audio_ref1.tooltip: LTXV Audio VAE Encode output for pic1. Requires an AVref LoRA.

audio_ref2.tooltip: LTXV Audio VAE Encode output for pic2. Leave empty to preserve its audio time window.

msr_parameters.tooltip: Optional MSR parameters from the LTX MSR IC-LoRA Loader. When omitted, references are appended as standard LTX guides without MSR slot embeddings or negative temporal offsets.

audio.tooltip: The audio to add to the video.

bit_depth.tooltip: Auto uses 8-bit for sRGB and 10-bit for HDR. Explicit 8-bit and 10-bit choices are independent of colorspace.

color_space.tooltip: Colorspace of the input images. HDR selects BT.2020/HLG and HDR PQ selects BT.2020/PQ.

images.tooltip: The images to create a video from.

video.tooltip: The video to extract components from.

tile_frames.tooltip: Window length in pixel frames, used only when use_streaming is on. Snapped to 8n+1. Must match LTXVTiledFusionSampler. Ignored when use_streaming is off.

use_streaming.tooltip: Off (default): encode the whole clip as one IC-LoRA guide. On: re-encode one fresh guide per LTXVTiledFusionSampler temporal window and write the plan the sampler reads. Set tile_frames on this node and the sampler to the same value (97 for LTX).

crop.tooltip: Crop mode when resizing. 'center' crops to fit, 'disabled' stretches to fit.

frame_idx.tooltip:
RoPE position of the reference, in pixel frames.
0 aligns the reference with the generated clip. Use for video references.
>0 places the reference at a specific pixel-frame position in the clip.
-1 places the reference outside the generated frame range, while still using it for attention conditioning. Use for single-image references.
For multi-frame references, >0 values are rounded down to 1 mod 8.

latent.tooltip: Video-only latent to condition. Must be a 5D video latent (batch, channels, frames, height, width).

latent_downscale_factor.tooltip: For IC-LoRA on small grid. 1 means original size, 2 means half size, 3 means third, etc.

tile_overlap.tooltip: Overlap between tiles for tiled encoding. Only used when use_tiled_encode is enabled.

tile_size.tooltip: Spatial tile size for tiled encoding. Only used when use_tiled_encode is enabled.

use_tiled_encode.tooltip: Enable tiled VAE encoding for large resolutions/long videos to reduce memory usage.

attention_mask.tooltip: Optional pixel-space spatial mask. Controls per-region conditioning influence via self-attention, multiplied by strength.

iclora_parameters.tooltip: Optional IC-LoRA parameters from a Get IC-LoRA Parameters node. Used for adjusting guide processing as required by certain IC-LoRAs (eg. those with a reference_downscale_factor > 1). When chained, each LTXVAddGuide uses only the parameters connected to it.

frame_idx.tooltip: Frame index to start the conditioning at. For single-frame images or videos with 1-8 frames, any frame_idx value is acceptable. For videos with 9+ frames, frame_idx must be divisible by 8, otherwise it will be rounded down to the nearest multiple of 8. Negative values are counted from the end of the video.

image.tooltip: Image or video to condition the latent video on. Must be 8*n + 1 frames. If the video is not 8*n + 1 frames, it will be cropped to the nearest 8*n + 1 frames.

audio_vae.tooltip: The Audio VAE model used for decoding the latent.
The Audio VAE model to use for encoding.
The Audio VAE model to get configuration from.

batch_size.tooltip: The number of latent audio samples in the batch.

image.tooltip: Optional video/image batch. When connected, width, height, and frame_count are taken from it (Get Image Size style).

frame_count.tooltip: Source frame count. tile_frames is 8n+1, 97 or less, or up to 121 when that avoids temporal chunking.

initial_canvas_size.tooltip: Stage-1 canvas long-edge (same choices as tile size). Source within 200px of FullHD is kept instead of rescaled.

output_size.tooltip: Final canvas. FullHD is the 1920 long-edge step; 4K is 2× that; 8K is 4×. Single-stage graphs use this as the canvas. Two-stage graphs use initial canvas for stage 1 and this for stage 2.

tile_size.tooltip: Spatial tile long-edge. qHD=960, HD=1280, FullHD=1920. Clamped to the initial canvas so a FullHD tile on a smaller canvas does not force tiling.

width.tooltip: Source width in pixels (from Load Video / Get Image Size).

img_compression.tooltip: Amount of compression to apply on image.

canvas_device.tooltip: Where to keep the full-canvas tensors and cached tile latents/noise/masks. auto = GPU if there is enough free memory, otherwise CPU. Processed conds stay on the GPU.

vae.tooltip: Used to read the model's temporal and spatial downscale factors. If omitted, they are taken from the diffusion model (LTX defaults: 8 frames and 32 pixels per latent cell).

blend_var.tooltip: Variance of the Gaussian blend weights in the overlaps. Leave at 0.05 unless you are measuring seams.

cfg.tooltip: Classifier-free guidance scale. Distilled models typically use 1.0.

grid_cycle.tooltip: Cycle shifted tile grids across steps. 1 = fixed grid (cheapest), 4 = thorough. Spatial only: cycling the temporal grid slides content in time.

latents.tooltip: The latent RETURNED BY the IC-LoRA guide node (it carries appended guide frames plus the noise mask). A bare empty video latent will not work.

negative.tooltip: Negative conditioning from the IC-LoRA guide node.

overlap_frac.tooltip: Fraction of each tile overlapping its neighbor. Stay at 0.5 or above: below that a periodic grid appears on structured content.

positive.tooltip: Positive conditioning from the IC-LoRA guide node. Must carry keyframe_idxs / guide_attention_entries so each tile can be cropped to the LoRA's trained window.

sampler.tooltip: From KSamplerSelect (same type as SamplerCustomAdvanced). Discrete step samplers only: euler, euler_ancestral, heun, dpm_2, … History methods (DPM++ 2M, LMS) lose their multi-step memory because fusion owns the loop. Adaptive samplers cannot fuse. Ancestral methods add independent noise per tile and can seam.

seed.tooltip: Seed for the single shared noise field across all tiles.

sigmas.tooltip: Denoise schedule. Must be descending and end at 0. Fusion walks this list one step at a time.

tile_frames.tooltip: Temporal window in pixel frames (97 for LTX). 0 = one extent. Other values are snapped to 8n+1. >0 needs LTXAddVideoICLoRAGuide with use_streaming on and the SAME tile_frames: that re-encodes a fresh guide per window and writes the plan this sampler reads. A whole-clip guide cannot be sliced, and windowing is disabled if the plan is missing.

tile_height.tooltip: Tile height in pixels, multiple of 32. Match tile_width to the IC-LoRA's trained spatial window.

tile_width.tooltip: Tile width in pixels, multiple of 32. Set this to the IC-LoRA's trained spatial window. Tiles smaller than the trained window make every tile see content at the wrong scale.

crop.tooltip: How to handle aspect ratio mismatch: 'disabled' stretches to fit, 'center' crops to maintain aspect ratio.

height.tooltip: Target height in pixels. Set to 0 to auto-calculate from width while preserving aspect ratio.

width.tooltip: Target width in pixels. Set to 0 to auto-calculate from height while preserving aspect ratio.

multiplier.tooltip: Scale factor (e.g., 2.0 doubles size, 0.5 halves size).

longer_size.tooltip: The longer edge will be resized to this value. Aspect ratio is preserved.

shorter_size.tooltip: The shorter edge will be resized to this value. Aspect ratio is preserved.

width.tooltip: Target width in pixels. Height auto-adjusts to preserve aspect ratio.

height.tooltip: Target height in pixels. Width auto-adjusts to preserve aspect ratio.

megapixels.tooltip: Target total megapixels (e.g., 1.0 ≈ 1024×1024). Aspect ratio is preserved.

crop.tooltip: How to handle aspect ratio mismatch: 'disabled' stretches to fit, 'center' crops to maintain aspect ratio.

match.tooltip: Resize input to match the dimensions of this reference image or mask.

multiple.tooltip: Resize so width and height are divisible by this number. Useful for latent alignment (e.g., 8 or 64).

resize_type.tooltip: Select how to resize: by exact dimensions, scale factor, matching another image, etc.

scale_method.tooltip: Interpolation algorithm. 'area' is best for downscaling, 'lanczos' for upscaling, 'nearest-exact' for pixel art.

crf.tooltip: Lower values produce higher quality and larger files.

encoding.tooltip: Automatic preserves compatible H.264 streams. Re-encode applies custom encoding options.

codec.tooltip: The output video codec. Auto preserves a compatible source stream. H.264 and AV1 re-encoding support SDR, HDR (HLG), and HDR PQ.

filename_prefix.tooltip: The prefix for the file to save. This may include formatting information such as %date:yyyy-MM-dd% or %Empty Latent Image.width% to include values from nodes.

start_index.tooltip: Start time in seconds, can be negative to count from the end (supports sub-seconds).

temporal_overlap.tooltip: Only used for video VAEs: Amount of frames to overlap.

temporal_size.tooltip: Only used for video VAEs: Amount of frames to decode at a time.
